items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out with dislocated left elbow (no fracture on X-ray); expected to miss time (prior similar ~1 month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on play; Quinn confirmed, additional testing Monday; X-rays negative.
items.implication: Sit ROS short-term; backup QB situation; hurts skill players.
items.opportunity: Monitor Commanders WR/RB volume with backup.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today despite cracked rib; previously GTD with optimism and flak jacket possible.
items.why: Officially active after limited Friday practice and Rapoport bullish tone on improvement/pushing to play.
items.implication: Start as WR2; docks for rib but primary target if playing.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected vs Raiders if no setback.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today with hamstring; was not expected and confirmed on inactives.
items.why: Hamstring limited practice; Schefter morning unlikely, confirmed inactive.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for J.K. Dobbins and backups.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) true GTD for MNF, trending wrong direction/may sit after missing practices.
items.why: Schefter: trending wrong way; missed Fri/Sat practices; different from prior issue.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out elevates Adams etc.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Davante Adams target boost, TEs/RBs more involved.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow officially active vs Texans after questionable (back); expected to play.
items.why: Rapoport confirmed will play; Schefter active list.
items.implication: Start with confidence; full offense online with Chase etc.
items.opportunity: Normal pass volume, red-zone for weapons.

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: 'Close, very close. He looks great.' toward return.
items.implication: Potential near-term return; stash/start soon; Mayer temporary.

items.text: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yds, TD in each of first two games.
items.implication: Lock-in WR1; high target/route share continuing.

items.text: Long Sunday injury watchlist: Caleb Williams (ham), Daniels (elbow), Barkley (stinger), Price (chest), Reed (head), Brooks (groin), Dowdle (toe), Jones (knee), Dobbins (ham), Goedert (knee), Evans (hip not serious), etc.
items.why: In-game/postgame reports; Levitan notes longest list recalled.
items.implication: Check Monday reports for severity/miss time; impact waivers/ROS.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups for affected (e.g. if Dobbins limited).

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return with chest injury.
items.why: In-game chest; on ETR Sunday injury list.
items.opportunity: If out: other Seahawks RBs more carries.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury, questionable to return; Shanahan says doesn't look serious (high ankle for Robinson).
items.implication: Monitor; likely short-term if any miss.
items.opportunity: If out: other 49ers WRs/TEs more targets.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return in-game.
items.why: Stinger in-game; listed on ETR watchlist.
items.implication: Monitor return; handcuff if out long.
items.opportunity: If limited/out: Gainwell or other backs elevated snaps/carries.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave active; ETR/Levitan projected clean with no docks after hamstring.
items.why: Expected to play; Levitan no real docks.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, status likely late (2:30pm ET).
items.why: Optimism + flak possible; bullish insider tone; later confirmed active.
items.implication: Include in projections/lineups with volume discount for rib.
items.opportunity: Still primary WR targets/routes despite docks.

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey sounding doubtful/inactive (hamstring).
items.why: Harvey doubtful; Coleman opportunity in backfield with Dobbins.
items.implication: Grab Coleman if available for depth; monitor snaps.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers OUT with hamstring; opens door for increased targets elsewhere.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed in weekend summary and Rapoport notes.
items.implication: Sit; Bateman/others elevated but monitor usage.
items.opportunity: Route/target share boost for remaining Ravens WRs.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman OUT with foot; expect look at Germie Bernard.
items.why: Foot injury; ETR/Levitan/Berry note Bernard stash/YAC fit with McCarthy.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; stash/monitor Bernard in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Slot/YAC targets for Bernard and remaining Colts WRs.

items.text: Agrees on Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, good McCarthy fit) with Pittman out; also Sarratt deep.
items.why: Pittman out opens; Bernard YAC/slot fit.
items.opportunity: Potential target/YAC share in Colts offense.
